nodes.title: The first exchange
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Before the island, before the legend, there was a first opponent. On a quiet shore, Arima Kihei waits. A name can be won in a moment. A way of living takes longer.

nodes.title: How will you meet him?
nodes.text: Arima rests a hand on his sword. The distance between you is still yours to choose.

choices.text: Bow. Study his footing.
Breathe. Find your own rhythm.
Challenge him. Let the shore remember.

nodes.title: A measured beginning
nodes.speaker: ARIMA
nodes.text: A bow is easy. Show me whether your guard has the same patience.

nodes.title: One breath
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: The wind crosses the court. Your shoulders settle. Read the cut. Match its zone. Meet the steel at the last moment, and answer while he recoils.

nodes.title: A name carried on the wind
nodes.speaker: ARIMA
nodes.text: Then earn the sound of your name. Words cannot hold a blade away.

nodes.title: The silence after steel
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Arima falls to his knees. The exchange is over. What follows will travel farther than the sound of the final cut.

nodes.title: What will you leave behind?
nodes.text: A defeated opponent. A watching world. Your next act belongs to you.

choices.text: Spare him. Offer a hand.
Kill him. Claim the victory.

nodes.title: The ground is not the end
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Your footing fails. Pain stays with you, but the road does not close. You leave the court wounded. You can return carrying what this defeat has taught you.

nodes.title: Will you return?
nodes.text: The wound reduces your breath and speed. The choice to rise is still yours.

choices.text: Yes. Gather yourself, then face him again.
No. Walk on with the lesson.

nodes.title: A moment beside the water
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Rest beside the water. Let your mouth and brow soften. Hold a calm expression until the ink circle closes. A broken stroke is only an invitation to begin again.

nodes.title: A hand, not another cut
nodes.text: You offer a hand instead of another cut. The road carries you toward Kyoto, where the Yoshioka name waits.

nodes.title: A name at a cost
nodes.text: You leave with a victory others will repeat. The road carries you toward Kyoto, where the Yoshioka name waits.

nodes.title: The Ronin
nodes.text: You walk away carrying a wound and a lesson. The road remains open, even when victory does not. Your journey belongs to you.

nodes.title: The Yoshioka challenge
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: In Kyoto, a school's reputation becomes a single drawn blade. Yoshioka Denshichiro offers you a choice of ground. His first movement may be a lie.

nodes.title: Choose your ground
nodes.text: The ground changes the encounter. What do you seek?

choices.text: The open court. Meet him plainly.
The grove. Let patience answer pride.
The lantern court. Let others remember.

nodes.title: An open challenge
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: No shadows to hide behind. Watch his withdrawal: a feint changes the zone before the real cut.

nodes.title: Beneath the pines
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: The grove closes around the court. Keep your gaze centered to read his feints; let the false cut pass.

nodes.title: By the lanterns
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Small flames surround the court. Reputation has brought you here. Timing will decide whether you leave standing.

nodes.title: A school falls silent
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Yoshioka lowers his blade. The reputation you came to challenge is now in your hands.

nodes.title: How will Kyoto remember?
nodes.text: The exchange is won. Choose its final meaning.

choices.text: Spare him. Leave the school its dignity.
Claim his life and the tale of victory.

nodes.title: Pride meets the ground
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: A changed angle defeats your guard. The wound will travel with you, but this defeat need not decide the road.

nodes.title: Rise for another exchange?
nodes.text: You can gather your composure or leave Kyoto behind.

choices.text: Return. Rest, then challenge him again.
Leave the challenge and walk onward.

nodes.title: Stillness beneath the pines
nodes.text: Draw the circle. Begin again.

nodes.title: Toward Ganryujima
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: The road ends at water. Across the channel waits Sasaki Kojiro, whose long blade gives the distance a different meaning.

nodes.title: When will you arrive?
nodes.text: The boat is ready. What will your arrival say?

choices.text: On time. Honor the agreed dawn.
Late. Make him wait on the sand.

nodes.title: Dawn on the island
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: The sea is quiet. Kojiro waits in ivory lacquer. His Swallow Cut sweeps LOW, then returns HIGH. Parry either cut to break the sequence, or leave his long reach.

nodes.title: A sun already rising
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Kojiro has waited. His long sword has not grown shorter. The Swallow Cut begins LOW and returns HIGH: one opening can become two threats.

nodes.title: After the swallow
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: The long blade stills. Waves erase the marks of your feet. What survives this island is the way you choose to leave it.

nodes.title: What remains after victory?
nodes.text: You have reached the end of the challenge.

choices.text: Lower the sword. Let the rivalry end.
Take his life. Carry the undefeated name.

nodes.title: The return cuts deep
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: The long blade finds its mark. You leave the sand wounded. A final defeat is still a place from which to rise.

nodes.title: Will you face the island again?
nodes.text: The boat can wait for your next breath.

choices.text: Yes. Rest, heal, and return.
No. Carry the lesson beyond the island.

nodes.title: An enso beside the sea
nodes.text: Let the circle close. Return to the sand.

nodes.title: The Way
nodes.text: You won the island and found a reason to lower your blade. Honor weighs more than a perfect record. What you carry forward is a practice: meet the next moment with a steadier hand.

nodes.title: The Undefeated
nodes.text: Arima. Yoshioka. Kojiro. No challenge brought you down. Your name crosses the water before you do. Whether that name becomes a burden or a beginning remains yours to decide.

nodes.title: The Ronin
nodes.text: Victory and defeat have both marked your road. You leave without a perfect legend to hide behind. You have learned how to stand again, and the horizon still has room for your next step.
